meta.doctrine: SCOUT nominations only — a candidate carries no citation weight until approved into sources.json by the human/Fable tiering review. Rejections are kept with their reasons; they teach the scout. See agents/SCOUT.md.

queue.name: ONA (Oman News Agency)
queue.fills: The exact source class the Oman-struck VERIFY dispute was waiting on — registry has QNA and WAM but no Omani official channel, despite Oman hosting the mediation.
queue.evidence: ONA official-source statement on the 13 Jul Duqm drone strike (two drones, one injured, debris near fuel storage) closed the dispute in the A/B re-run; reached via Anadolu/Argus republication.
queue.risks: State wire — reflects Omani government position; slow on anything Muscat wants quiet.

queue.name: Oman MFA (fm.gov.om)
queue.fills: Direct read on the mediator's posture — statements published same-day during the 13 Jul cycle; the diplomatic-track health check for Muscat talks.
queue.evidence: fm.gov.om statement 13 Jul condemning attacks and calling for an immediate regional halt, hours after hosting Iran's FM.
queue.risks: Official diplomatic language only; deliberately non-specific on operational detail.

queue.name: BNA (Bahrain News Agency)
queue.fills: Gulf-official-wire gap: Bahrain is a confirmed retaliation target every round and hosts NSA Bahrain / 5th Fleet; no Bahraini official channel in the registry.
queue.evidence: Bahrain named in every round's confirmed strike list; confirmations currently arrive only via US/Qatari media carriage.
queue.risks: State wire; incident detail may lag or be suppressed for base-security reasons.

queue.name: KUNA (Kuwait News Agency)
queue.fills: Same Gulf-official-wire gap as BNA — Kuwait is a standing retaliation target with no official channel in the registry.
queue.evidence: Kuwait in every confirmed strike list 12-13 Jul; no direct Kuwaiti official sighting in any gather run to date.
queue.risks: State wire; same caveats as BNA.

queue.name: Naval News
queue.fills: USV/naval-platform identification — the sea-drone war makes platform-level naval OSINT load-bearing (pattern-stress driver from 13 Jul).
queue.evidence: Same-day identification of the 3 Saronic Corsair USVs and the Bandar Abbas submarine/maintenance target in the Round-4 strikes — detail neither wire copy nor CENTCOM's own post carried.
queue.risks: Trade press — strong on platforms, not a confirmation source for contested kinetic claims.

queue.name: Argus Media
queue.fills: Energy-market wire with fast Gulf incident coverage — bridges the market lane and the kinetic lane (Kpler/Windward cover flows, not incidents).
queue.evidence: Carried the Oman Duqm drone-attack report with ONA sourcing on 13 Jul, ahead of most general-news outlets.
queue.risks: Some content paywalled; use via headlines/snippets and record via:.

queue.name: Insurance Journal
queue.fills: War-risk/insurance-market lane reachable without the Lloyd's paywall — and it carried the AIS-dark transit story the transit-count decomposition depends on.
queue.evidence: 13 Jul piece 'Ships Transit Hormuz in Secret' (Kpler data: all six Sunday transits AIS-dark) — the key to decomposing the 6-vs-14-vs-8.5M-bbl number conflict.
queue.risks: Republishes wire/Bloomberg copy — decompose to primaries per GATHER rule.

queue.name: hormuzmonitor.com
queue.fills: Redundancy for the live-transit dashboards (straits.live, hormuztracking.com) — dashboard divergence is itself a signal when AIS goes dark.
queue.evidence: Live ship-data page surfaced in the 13 Jul re-run alongside the two registry dashboards; cross-checking three trackers exposes methodology gaps.
queue.risks: Unknown operator and methodology; treat as T1 until its counts are benchmarked against PortWatch.

queue.name: FDD Overnight Brief
queue.fills: Daily curated round-up of Iran/Gulf coverage with primary links — a cheap morning sweep seed for the EN lane.
queue.evidence: 13 Jul edition aggregated the day's Iran-war coverage with source links; useful as a query-seeder, never as a citation.
queue.risks: Advocacy-adjacent think tank (hawkish Iran line) — aggregation only, decompose to primaries, never cite the brief itself.
